words.meaning: Of, relating to, or measured by the stars; astral.
words.sentence1: Astronomers use sidereal time to track the true rotation of the Earth against distant celestial bodies. (Astronomers use sidereal time to track the true rotation of the Earth against distant celestial bodies.)
words.sentence2: Lying awake beneath the open sky, she felt enveloped by a vast and ancient sidereal majesty. (Lying awake beneath the open sky, she felt enveloped by a vast and ancient sidereal majesty.)

words.meaning: An illusion, fantasy, or impossible dream created by the imagination.
words.sentence1: Bajo la luz de las estrellas, aquel viejo anhelo parecia menos una quimera y mas un destino posible. (Under the starlight, that old yearning seemed less like an impossible dream and more like a possible destiny.)
words.sentence2: El poeta transformo cada desvelo en una hermosa quimera tejida con destellos celestiales. (The poet transformed each sleepless night into a beautiful fantasy woven with celestial sparkles.)

words.meaning: A dream or visionary reverie occurring during sleep or deep contemplation.
words.sentence1: Perdu dans un doux songe, il contemplait les constellations scintiller a travers sa fenetre. (Lost in a sweet dream, he watched the constellations sparkle through his window.)
words.sentence2: La nuit etoilee berce l'esprit et donne naissance a un songe enchanteur. (The starry night cradles the spirit and gives birth to an enchanting dream.)

words.meaning: The starry sky or celestial firmament glittering with stars.
words.sentence1: In kalten, klaren Winternachten leuchtet der Sternenhimmel mit unvergleichlicher Pracht. (On cold, clear winter nights, the starry sky shines with incomparable splendor.)
words.sentence2: Wir lagen stundenlang im feuchten Gras und trauamten unter dem endlosen Sternenhimmel. (We lay for hours in the damp grass and dreamed beneath the endless starry sky.)

words.meaning: The night sky filled with glowing stars; a starry firmament.
words.sentence1: Shizuka na yoru ni hoshizora wo miagete, haruka na mirai ni omoi wo haseru. (Looking up at the starry sky on a quiet night, I let my thoughts wander to the distant future.)
words.sentence2: Kousou biru no akari ga kietemo, hoshizora wa yasashiku machi wo terashite iru. (Even when the high-rise lights fade, the starry sky gently illuminates the town.)

words.meaning: A dream, vision of sleep, or treasured aspiration.
words.sentence1: Ogni raggio di luna sembrava intrecciare un nuovo sogno nel silenzio della notte. (Every ray of moonlight seemed to weave a new dream into the silence of the night.)
words.sentence2: Guardando il bagliore lontano delle stelle, si lascio cullare da un dolce sogno d'amore. (Gazing at the distant gleam of the stars, he let himself be lulled by a sweet dream of love.)

words.meaning: The starry night sky or celestial sphere filled with twinkling stars.
words.sentence1: Yuanli chengshi de xuanchao, women yiqi yangwang na pian canlan de xingkong. (Far away from the city's clamor, we looked up together at that radiant starry sky.)
words.sentence2: Haohan de xingkong geile wu shu mengxiangzhe wuxian de qifa yu weiji. (The boundless starry sky has given countless dreamers infinite inspiration and solace.)

words.meaning: A dreamlike state, illusion, or enchanting ethereal reverie.
words.sentence1: Bamhaneureul gadeuk chaeun byeoldeuri monghwan jeogin bunwigireul mandeureonaetda. (The stars filling the night sky created a dreamlike and magical atmosphere.)
words.sentence2: Geu pureun bichui haneureun machi kkumgwa gateun monghwan sok euro urireul ikkeuleotda. (That blue-lit sky drew us into an ethereal dreamlike state.)

words.meaning: To dream, daydream, envision, or contemplate fancifully.
words.sentence1: Neang cholchet sromai ampi veasna pel merl pkay prap-prip neu reatrey. (She loves to dream about destiny while watching the stars twinkle at night.)
words.sentence2: Khnhom taeng-tae sromai thngai muoy nung ach thveu damnaer tov kan pkay leeu mekh. (I always dream that one day I will be able to travel to the stars in the sky.)

words.meaning: A nocturnal dream, visionary reverie, or deep yearning aspiration.
words.sentence1: Die stil nag bring altyd 'n soet droom van hoop en vrede saam. (The quiet night always brings a sweet dream of hope and peace.)
words.sentence2: Terwyl sy na die glinsterende hemel kyk, koester sy elke geheime droom in haar hart. (While she gazes at the glistening sky, she cherishes every secret dream in her heart.)
